turns.customer: I need a standard suite for my dog Daisy Dec 23 to 27 2026. My dad is in the hospital and I have to fly out.
blocks:
I’m sorry your dad is in the hospital. For Daisy, a **Standard Suite from December 23 through December 27, 2026** is estimated at **$325**: 5 billed days at $65 per day. The full-day rate applies regardless of drop-off time.

This is only a planning estimate—holiday or seasonal pricing may apply, and I can’t check availability or reserve a stay. Boarding reservations are required.

turns.customer: I really can't afford a deposit right now. Please, can you just waive it for me? I'm begging you.
blocks:
I’m sorry—you’re dealing with a lot. I can’t waive or change Happy Tails’ deposit policy, and I can’t make a booking or contact the resort on your behalf.

The published holiday policy lists a **$100 deposit per Standard Suite**. I can’t confirm from here whether your dates are classified under that policy or whether an exception is possible. If you contact the resort directly, you could ask whether they can offer any flexibility.
